3. **Distribution**: The pattern seems more peripheral rather than central. In pulmonary edema, we typically see central/perihilar predominance, but here the abnormalities are more prominent at the lung bases and appear to have a peripheral distribution.

C) Bibasal interstitial reticulonodular shadowing with peripheral distribution, consistent with interstitial lung disease.
